current_variant = None

for v in prod_data['variants']:
    if v['item_id'] == current_item_id:
        current_variant = v
    elif v['available']:
        alternatives.append(v)

print("=== YOUR CURRENT ITEM ===")

print(f"  Options: {current_variant['options']}")
